# Screenshots

The main README uses a clearly labelled placeholder until screenshots are
captured for PatchNode. Add captures with the **exact file names** below (PNG)
when they are ready.

When `hero.png` is ready, replace the `placeholder.svg` image in the root
README with it; the other listed service captures can be added to their
sections there.

**Privacy first.** Take every capture in the app's **demo mode** ("Try the demo" on
the welcome screen, or in Settings) or on a demo homelab. If you use
your own servers, blur or replace every IP address, domain, host name, user
name, token and serial number before committing. Remember that the repository
history keeps every version of a file forever.

Suggested sizes keep the repository light: export at the device's native
resolution, then downscale to the width given here (the README displays them
at 260 px, or 900 px for the hero image). Run them through an optimizer such as
ImageOptim.

| File | Screen | Device | Suggested size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hero.png` | Dashboard on the three devices side by side (light mode), demo data | iPhone + iPad + Mac composite | 1800 × 1000 |
| `proxmox.png` | Proxmox tab: nodes with CPU/RAM, list of VMs and containers | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `proxmox-backup-server.png` | Proxmox Backup Server: datastores and recent tasks | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `docker.png` | Docker tab: containers grouped by stack, one unhealthy | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `compose.png` | Docker Compose editor with the diff view, or a Proxmox console in the terminal | iPad (landscape) or iPhone | 1376 × 1032 (iPad) or 780 × 1688 |
| `tailscale.png` | Tailscale: devices with last seen and key expiry | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `grafana.png` | Observability: Grafana alerts and dashboards list | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `prometheus.png` | Observability: a PromQL favorite chart and targets | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `uptime-kuma.png` | Uptime Kuma monitors with heartbeats | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `crowdsec.png` | Security: CrowdSec active decisions | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `nginx-proxy-manager.png` | Security: Nginx Proxy Manager proxy hosts | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `adguard-home.png` | Security: AdGuard Home statistics and top domains | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `home-assistant.png` | Home Assistant: pinned entities, scenes and scripts | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |
| `glances.png` | Glances: CPU, memory, load, file systems | iPhone | 780 × 1688 |

The demo mode uses fictional names and documentation addresses
(`*.patchnode-demo.invalid`, `192.0.2.0/24` and the other documentation
ranges), so its captures need no blurring.
